title: CAUTION — The Dark Side (Safety Awareness)

video_prompt.subject: The same young girl from Scene 1, sitting alone in her room while chatting on her smartphone with an unknown online stranger
video_prompt.action: She reads incoming messages on her glowing phone screen when a flashing red AI safety alert suddenly interrupts the chat. Her expression changes from curiosity to concern. She quickly stops typing, closes the chat window, places the phone face down, steps away from it, and immediately calls her mother for help.
video_prompt.setting: Quiet home bedroom in the evening, dim ambient lighting, soft shadows across the room, phone screen casting glow on her face
video_prompt.background_elements: Desk lamp faintly glowing, schoolbooks left open on table, curtains moving gently in night breeze, warning light reflections flickering across walls
video_prompt.camera_movement: Starts with an extreme close-up on suspicious incoming messages, cuts to dramatic close-up of flashing red warning alert, then slowly pulls back into a wide cinematic shot as she steps away from the phone
video_prompt.cinematic_effects: Screen glow illuminating her worried face, flashing red warning reflections, subtle screen glitch effect during alert trigger, shallow depth of field for emotional tension
video_prompt.color_grade: Cool blue-grey cinematic tones with bold warning red highlights and muted shadows
video_prompt.style: Tense, cautionary, realistic, cinematic, emotionally impactful
video_prompt.tone_shift: Clear dramatic contrast from previous warm scenes — colder, darker, and more serious atmosphere
creative_enhancements: Suspicious chat messages appear as floating translucent message bubbles around the phone before disappearing at alert trigger
Red warning alert expands holographically across the screen with animated flashing hazard lines
Subtle digital glitch ripple effect symbolizes hidden online danger
As she steps away, the phone glow fades sharply to emphasize her decision to stay safe

voiceover.text: But beware! Misinformation can come through AI too. Don't trust strangers. Never share your personal information with anyone.
voiceover.delivery_style: Serious, protective, cautionary narrator tone with strong emphasis on safety warnings

audio.sfx: Low tension ambient drone, warning alert ping, faint notification buzz, sudden silence after chat closes
audio.music: Suspenseful low string underscore with dramatic pause after warning alert appears

safety_message.alert_icon: Flashing warning triangle with exclamation mark

visual_symbolism.theme: Technology requires smart and safe choices
symbolic_elements: Red warning alert represents digital danger detection
Fading phone glow symbolizes stepping away from online risk
Calling her mother represents trust in real-world guidance and protection
